parts.description: Intent keyed by stable leaf keys from draftwright parts or merged common-name stems (docs/model.md). Unknown keys are refused with valid keys.

separate.description: Keep this leaf product out of geometry merges; address leaf keys, not a merged-only stem.

stock.description: Case-insensitive stock status; spaces, underscores and hyphens are normalised. Known aliases match the file reader.

include.description: Default: GA front sheet for more than one group. False omits it; true forces it for one group. Counts in pack SHEET numbering.

drawing.description: Existing view, A4-first sheet/scale, hidden-line, title and envelope-dimension intent for the assembled product. Hidden defaults false. Recognised threads use the existing conventional carriers; sheet/view thread_depiction false selects physical geometry. No exploded geometry.

balloon_radius.description: Item-reference circle radius in paper mm; default 6, distinct from inspection characteristic rings and hole-table TAG rings.

balloons.description: One reference per group, keyed by final pack item number, including bought items. Unknown items refused.

parts_list.description: Default true: bottom-up parts list directly above title-block furniture, item 1 at the bottom. False omits it.

horizontal_axis.description: Source axis to read horizontally; default longest assembly axis. All principal cameras share one proper-rigid frame.

sections.description: Default true: recover indistinguishable or enclosed items in a full section through the item centre, with a cutting plane on plan.

details.description: Default true: enlarge a section region when an item wall is thinner than 0.7 paper mm; section recovery must be enabled.

hatching.description: Section hatch intent by final item number. Defaults use distinct angle/spacing combinations by item; longitudinal screws, pins, rods, shafts and washers are not hatched.

section_item.description: Choose the item whose centre selects the full-section plane. Forces recovery for this item; sections must be enabled.

detail_scale.description: Override the enlarged region standard scale; it must exceed the carrying section scale.

view.description: Choose the visible carrying view. A group hidden in that view is reported, never given a false leader.

position.description: Ring centre [dx,dy] in paper mm relative to carrying view origin (y up). Omit to use aligned outside bands.

omit.description: Null: automatic longitudinal-standard-part exception. True: omit hatch. False: force hatch.
